alkylation reagent: alkylated with 40 mM Iodoacetamide for 20 mins RT in the dark.
alkylation concentration: alkylated with 40 mM Iodoacetamide for 20 mins RT in the dark.
cleavage agent: 10 μL of a buffer of TEAB (Triethylammonium bicarbonate) pH 8 and 0.1% Sodium deoxycholate (SDC) is then added to the washed beads along with 100 ng trypsin.
collision energy: HCD fragmentation (NCE 34) with the ion trap scanning out in rapid mode
enrichment method: HA-tagged proteins were immune precipitated for 2.5 h at 4 °C using Ezview anti-HA agarose
fragmentation method: HCD fragmentation (NCE 34) with the ion trap scanning out in rapid mode
instrument: Data were acquired on an Orbitrap Fusion mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
labeling: Proteins were quantified using the Minora feature detector within Proteome Discoverer
reduction reagent: Eluted samples were reduced with 10 mM TCEP for 10 mins RT
reduction concentration: Eluted samples were reduced with 10 mM TCEP for 10 mins RT
